description: This file contains a final class ModifyFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl which is a builder class for creating responses and events related to a LiveCommand for modifying features in the Eclipse Ditto project. It implements the builder pattern with methods for generating specific command responses and event objects.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: A builder class for creating command responses and events related to a ModifyFeatureLiveCommand.

classes.name: ResponseFactoryImpl
classes.description: An immutable internal class implementing ResponseFactory, providing methods to create specific command responses.

classes.name: EventFactoryImpl
classes.description: An immutable internal class implementing EventFactory, providing methods to create feature created/modified event instances.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl for a given command.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a CommandResponse using a provided factory function.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates an Event instance using a provided factory function.
